cohort: Women who underwent liver transplantation between 1993 and 2016 and subsequently self-reported pregnancies at the Irish National Liver Transplant Unit.
finding: Short- and medium-term maternal outcomes are good for liver transplant recipients, with a high live birth rate and no maternal deaths during pregnancy; however, long-term maternal life expectancy is shortened, primarily due to liver graft failure.
who: Women who have undergone liver transplantation
